The '''son''' of a famous [[Unidentified Alderaanian nobleman (murdered son)|nobleman]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A [[Unidentified Alderaanian nobleman's alleged killer|man]] was arrested and incarcerated for the murder, but an individual later discovered the nobleman's son's journal&mdash;the contents of which proved the alleged killer to be innocent.<ref name="Lost Memories" />
